name: Zendesk Ticket Triage
summary: Automatically classifies Zendesk tickets, drafts replies for simple issues, and escalates VIP customer inquiries.

items.title: Incoming Zendesk tickets
items.description: Reads new incoming tickets from Zendesk to process them.
items.proved_when: New tickets appear in the system feed.

items.title: Ticket classifier and router
items.description: Analyzes ticket content to determine urgency level and route to the correct internal team.
items.proved_when: Tickets are successfully tagged with urgency and assigned team labels.

items.title: Simple reply drafter
items.description: Writes draft responses for straightforward tickets requiring standard answers.
items.proved_when: Draft replies are generated and saved on tickets deemed simple.
items.source_quote: draft a reply for simple ones

items.title: VIP ticket escalator
items.description: Flags tickets from VIP customers and escalates them immediately for priority handling.
items.proved_when: VIP customer tickets are marked urgent and highlighted in the dashboard.

items.title: Continuous triage schedule
items.description: Checks for new tickets every few minutes to ensure rapid response times.
items.proved_when: Tickets are processed automatically without manual trigger.

questions.text: Where should escalated VIP tickets be sent?

not_in_this_version.title: Auto-sending replies
not_in_this_version.reason: Drafts are generated for agent review rather than sent automatically to prevent customer friction.
